lines.en: I lumber toward the water.
My bulk is heavy; I walk slowly.
I press a path through the grass.
My tail swings at the flies.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方土都陷了
lines.en: The soil sinks where I pass.
I head for that river.
One step, one breath, steady.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤在太阳下发亮
lines.en: My hide shines in the sun.
I go around a stand of bushes.
I lower my head to inspect the grass.
I go on a stretch further.
I move toward the damp in the air.
I soak in the water, only my back showing.
The water is cool and good.
I open my mouth in a yawn.
The sun makes me drowsy.
A bird perches on my back.
In the river, only my nostrils show.
I lift my snout and sniff.
The grass here is thick.
I sink a little deeper.
Only my eyes show above the water.
I grunt low, and the water bubbles.
I rest my chin and stay still.
My ear flicks at a bug.
Ripples spread in rings.
Soaking in water, my health returns.
Soaking like this, I nearly fall asleep.

lines.zh: 我打了个响鼻，水花溅起
lines.en: I snort and water splashes.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把身体转了个向
lines.en: I turn my body slowly.

lines.zh: 热的时候，我只想在水里
lines.en: When it's hot, I want only the water.
The grass sways on the bank. I ignore it.

lines.zh: 你站得太靠水，我会误撞。
lines.en: You stand too near the water; I may bump you.
I raise my head, breaking the surface.
You shouldn't keep standing there.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一直没离开你，草岸太近了。
lines.en: My eyes never left you; the grassy bank is too close.
I yawn, showing my great teeth.

lines.zh: 你再待一会儿，我就上来
lines.en: Stay a little longer and I'll come out.

lines.zh: 泡在河里，我慢慢地转过来。
lines.en: Soaking in the river, I turn slowly.

lines.zh: 你把这里当成了安全的岸
lines.en: You take this bank for safe ground.
My nose blows out a breath.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢有人站我身后
lines.en: I don't like anyone behind me.
Back off a few steps, and I'll stay put.

lines.zh: 我一直在心里数着时间
lines.en: I've been counting the time.
This water is my ground.
When I come ashore, you must move.
I've grown very impatient.
If you won't go, I'll come myself.
I fall back half a step; water splashes.
This thick hide can take it.
I grunt, loudly.
Blood seeps into the water.
I open my mouth in warning.
I retreat slowly into the water.
A body this big can hurt too.
Even a body this big can hurt.
I stare at you without moving.
You'd best leave now.
Is that grass or fruit?
I smell it. Coming slowly.
I could finish that in one bite.
Set it down and I'll come up to eat.
That's far too little.
I prefer what I find myself.
Hold the melon high; I can still reach.
I climb slowly onto the bank.
That bite has mud on it.
I chew slowly. No hurry.
You hit me and fell back.
My bulk doesn't budge.
I shift slowly to clear the way.

lines.zh: 你的靴子压住我的尾巴。
lines.en: Your boot is pressing on my tail.
My hide is thick; a bump is nothing.
I turn sideways and block the bank.
The ground is churned where we stood.
Step back, and then I'll walk on.
I brush against you, wet.
Best not to block my way to the water.
We live by the water.
Soaking together is best.
You keep that end; I'll keep this.
The young should stay in the shallows.
When I go ashore, wait for me.
This bank has grazing enough.

lines.zh: 我没什么耐心，但对你还好
lines.en: I've little patience, but with you it's fine.
When you come near, I don't drive you off.
The water is quiet. Let's stay.
At dark we go ashore together.
I take it in one mouthful.
I do not bend down for things on the ground.
I nudge it with my snout.
Too small for me to notice.
One foot presses it into the mud.
This mouthful is grass and soil.
Two chews and I swallow.
You dropped it? I stepped on it.
I don't need to pick things up.
Leave these.
By day I soak. At night I come ashore.
I raise my head toward the bank.
Something keeps staying there.

lines.zh: 我从水里抬起头，正对着你。
lines.en: I lift my head from the water, facing you.
Water slides off my back.
My nostrils flare; it has begun.
I move two steps toward the bank.
The grass rustles under me.
I don't mean to wait any longer.
It's right on my path.
I climb the bank, step by step.
Water pours off me.
It retreats; I don't speed up.

lines.zh: 我一泡水就回血，你别急。
lines.en: Soaking in water heals me; do not hurry.
It's running for the houses.
This body doesn't run fast.
But I know this ground.
A ditch blocks it.
Now it's within my reach.
I stop where I am.
I open my mouth and bite.
These jaws can snap bone.
I bring my full weight down.
I knock it into the water.
I swing my head and the spray arrives first.
Blood mixes with the water.
I withdraw to the bank.
That will stay with it a long while.
I turn slowly back to the water.
The water is quiet now.
I surface from the river bend.
Water streams off my back.

lines.zh: 这里的草比我记得的高
lines.en: The grass is taller than I remember.
I slowly climb ashore.
The sun tightens my hide.
I head for a patch of shade.
When it's hot, I must go in the water.
I hear a river in the distance.
I lumber toward the thicker grass.
There's plenty of grass here.
I lower my head and begin to graze.
When I'm full, I'll go back to soak.

lines.zh: 皮被烤得发烫，我往水里冲
lines.en: My hide burns; I charge for the water.

lines.zh: 这么重摔下来，地面都塌了
lines.en: Falling this heavy, the ground gives.
Too deep; my feet find no bottom.
The blast shoves me back into the water.

lines.zh: 一根尖物扎进我的厚皮
lines.en: Something sharp sticks in my hide.
This force leaves me dizzy.
Not enough grass; I've lost weight.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面上，我抖了一下
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water; I shudder.
Heavy as I am, I fall too.
